pages.title: Allergies and medication
pages.description: What to avoid and what I take
pages.body:
## Allergies
- Penicillin: hives in 2019, use azithromycin instead
- Shellfish: mild, avoid prawns and crab

## Medication
- Cetirizine 10mg in spring (hay fever)
- Vitamin D 1000 IU daily from October to March

pages.title: Knee physiotherapy
pages.description: Exercises after the October knee strain
pages.body:
Physio: Dr. Amelia Ward at Riverside Clinic.

## Exercises
- [ ] Straight leg raises, 3×12, twice a day
- [ ] Wall sits, 3×30s
- [x] Ice after running for the first two weeks

> [!WARNING]
> No downhill running until the six-week review on 2026-12-04.

pages.title: Half marathon training plan
pages.description: 12 weeks to the March half marathon
pages.body:
Goal: finish the Lantau half marathon under 2 hours on 2027-03-14.

## Weekly shape
- Tuesday intervals: 6×800m at 5:10/km
- Thursday tempo 6 km
- Sunday long run, adding 1.5 km a week up to 18 km

## Shoes
Rotate the Pegasus (long runs) and the Endorphin (tempo). Replace the Pegasus after 700 km.

pages.title: Invoicing app
pages.description: Small invoicing tool for freelance work
pages.body:
## Decisions
- Database: PostgreSQL, because invoices need transactions and reporting queries; SQLite was too limiting for the multi-user plan.
- Hosting: a single Hetzner VM with Docker Compose.
- PDF invoices rendered with Typst.

## Open
- [ ] Add GST-style tax lines
- [ ] Email reminders for overdue invoices

pages.title: Deploy runbook
pages.body:
1. `make release` builds the image and tags it with the git SHA.
2. `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` on the VM.
3. Run migrations with `make migrate`.

Speed-up idea: cache the npm layer in CI; builds dropped from 9 to 3 minutes when tried.

pages.title: On-call handbook
pages.body:
## First five minutes
- Acknowledge the page in PagerDuty
- Check the status dashboard and recent deploys
- Post in #incidents with what you see

## Escalation
After 30 minutes without a fix, escalate to the secondary on-call, then to the engineering manager, Priya.

pages.title: Release process
pages.body:
Releases go out on Tuesdays and Thursdays before 3pm. Freeze from 20 December to 3 January.
Every release needs a changelog entry and a passing staging smoke test.

pages.title: Sourdough bread
pages.body:
500 g bread flour, 350 g water, 100 g starter, 10 g salt.
Bulk ferment 5 hours at 24°C with four sets of stretch and folds. Bake at 250°C covered for 20 minutes, then 230°C uncovered for 25.
